---
title: "Ethnic bias in stop and search"
output: html_document
date: "2025-09-11"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, cache = TRUE)

source("fit_single_model.R")
source("initial_analysis.R")
source("excursions_by_year.R")
source("load_area_data.R")
source("prior_sensitivity.R")
source("k_sensitivity.R")
source("posterior_predictive_checks.R")
```

Load the data:
```{r load-data,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
data <- load.stop.search.data()
areas <- load.areas.data()
```

Fit the model:
```{r fit-model}
set.seed(34982)
model <- fit.single.model(data)
```

Temporal Plot:
```{r plot-temporal,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
plot.temporal(model)
```

Compute overall excursion sets:
```{r overall-exset,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
overall.ex.sets <- compute.overall.excursion.sets(model, data)

overall.ex.sets
```

Plot overall excursion sets:
```{r plot-exset,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
plot.overall.excursion.sets(overall.ex.sets)
```

Compute ratios by force and year:
```{r compute-ratios-by-force-and-year,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
ratios.by.force.and.year <- compute.ratios.over.force.and.year(model)
```

Compute Asian excursion sets
```{r compute-asian-excursion-set-by-year}
asian.excursion.set.by.year <- compute.asian.excursion.sets.by.year(ratios.by.force.and.year)
```

Plot Asian excursion sets by year:
```{r,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
plot.excursion.set.by.year(asian.excursion.set.by.year, areas)
```

Compute Black excursion sets
```{r compute-black-excursion-set-by-year}
black.excursion.set.by.year <- compute.black.excursion.sets.by.year(ratios.by.force.and.year)
```

Plot Black excursion sets by year:
```{r,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
plot.excursion.set.by.year(black.excursion.set.by.year, areas)
```

Fit k-models
```{r k-fits,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
ks <- c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1)

k.models <- fit.models.with.varying.k(ks, data)
```


Plot k-models
```{r plot-k-fits,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
temporal.plot.varying.k(k.models)
```

Compute k-excursions
```{r k-excursions,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
k.excursions <- compute.excursion.sets.with.varying.k(k.models, data)
```

```{r}
k.excursions
```

Prior sensitivity
```{r alt-prior,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
alt.prior <- list(prior = "loggamma", params = c(2, 1))

model.alt.prior <- fit.single.model(data, iid_prior = alt.prior)

plot.temporal(model.alt.prior)

exsets.alt.prior <- compute.overall.excursion.sets(model.alt.prior, data)

plot.overall.excursion.sets(exsets.alt.prior)
```


RW1:
```{r rw1,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}

model.rw1 <- fit.single.model(data, time_model="rw1")

plot.temporal(model.rw1)

exsets.rw1 <- compute.overall.excursion.sets(model.rw1, data)

plot.overall.excursion.sets(exsets.rw1)
```

AR1:
```{r ar1,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}

model.ar1 <- fit.single.model(data, time_model="ar1")

plot.temporal(model.ar1)

exsets.ar1 <- compute.overall.excursion.sets(model.ar1, data)

plot.overall.excursion.sets(exsets.ar1)
```

Posterior predictive checks
```{r post-pred-checks,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
replicates <- compute.replicates(model, data)
plot.posterior.predictive.check(replicates)
```

```{r,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}

plot(model$summary.random$obs$mean, xlim=c(1100, 1200))

data[1100:1200,]$force

epsilons <- model$summary.random$obs %>%
  mutate(ID = as.integer(ID)) %>%
  arrange(ID) %>%
  select(mean)

epsilon.df <- data.frame(
  epsilon = epsilons[which(data$force == "lancashire"), ],
  ethnicity = data$ethnicity[which(data$force == "lancashire")],
  year = data$year[which(data$force == "lancashire")],
  crime = data$crime[which(data$force == "lancashire")]
) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(substr(year, 1, 4)) + 1
  )

ggplot(epsilon.df, aes(x = year, y = epsilon, colour = str_to_title(crime), linetype = str_to_title(ethnicity))) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Financial year beginning",
    y = "Posterior mean of epsilon",
    colour = "Crime type",
    linetype = "Ethnicity"
  )
```
